headline: Labelbox, which supplies training data and practice environments for AI models, has raised more than $100 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a solid round, but all figures are the company's own.
importance_line: AI labs that buy training data and testing tools are its customers; the profit and growth figures come only from Labelbox.
summary: Unite.AI reports, citing Labelbox's announcement, that Labelbox raised more than $100 million in a Series E round led by Infinitum Partners at a $1.25 billion valuation, using equity plus a credit facility. The company, which provides training data and practice environments for AI models, says it became profitable in 2026 and has more than 400 customers, figures that come from Labelbox itself.
notes: Source article is labelled AI-generated by Unite.AI; based on the company's blog post.
